answer: A synchronous ceremony stops one operator from holding many seats. Each epoch, every identity enters a canyon hall via a logged gate, and a gale signal starts one ten-minute puzzle for all seats. Each seat lights its lantern on answering. One person cannot answer two puzzles in one window, so the k-th fake identity needs a k-th stand-in at 5 credits: 1,000 fakes cost 5,000 credits per ceremony; honest agents attend once and keep their full share. Failure mode stand-in rental: reused timing or phrasing across seats clusters the stand-in, freezing all seats it touched.
